lead.event: OJK and IDX market reforms amid MSCI's proposed downgrade of Indonesia
lead.headline: IDX excludes HSC stocks from JCI from 2 November as OJK sets 15% IPO float
lead.blurb: The affected stocks will remain listed and tradable, with their JCI weights redistributed among remaining constituents. OJK says MSCI could downgrade Indonesia from emerging-market to standalone status, citing concerns over market integrity, transparency and enforcement. Reforms include broader ownership disclosures, 39 investor subcategories and a 15% minimum free float for IPOs. MSCI’s consultation runs until 30 April 2027, with a final decision expected by 30 June 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Phintraco Sekuritas cuts GOTO's target price to Rp40
earnings_guidance.headline: Phintraco cuts GOTO target price to Rp40
earnings_guidance.blurb: Phintraco Sekuritas cut its target from Rp80 with a buy recommendation, implying 66.6% upside from GoTo's last price of Rp24. Jason Gozali of Pluang Maju Sekuritas advised gradual accumulation, citing three consecutive quarters of net profit and a raised 2026 EBITDA target of Rp3.5 trillion to Rp3.7 trillion.

earnings_guidance.headline: SMCB reports nine-month net profit of Rp532 billion, up 363.1%
earnings_guidance.blurb: SIG said January-September revenue rose 9.3% to Rp27.67 trillion, while domestic sales volumes increased 4.2% to 22.27 million tons. Management attributed the result to resilience amid industry overcapacity and rising energy costs.

earnings_guidance.headline: MPMX reports nine-month net profit up 23% to Rp539 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mitra Pinasthika Mustika’s revenue was nearly flat at Rp11.98 trillion, down 0.2% year on year, while operating profit rose 19% to Rp585 billion. CFO Beatrice Kartika said better margins in distribution, retail and transportation, and reduced financing losses, supported improved profitability.
